Report actual context masses, objective, gradient norm, seed and stopping reason; no global optimum or unique embedding claim.

cpp.title: Learn typed directed triple scores with DistMult — cpp

Relations come only from the training split; duplicate triples collapse, distinct relation identities and self triples remain. Validation never affects fitting. cpp.title: Train a graph-based vertex classifier or regressor — cpp

Transductive unlabeled features/topology are explicit. Saved coefficients, split metrics, objective and convergence status; one self message, collapsed parallels, weights ignored.

cpp.title: Train a permutation-invariant graph predictor — cpp

cpp.title: Propagate geographic seed locations under a geodesic objective — cpp

Fixed seeds remain exact; seedless components remain unresolved. Haversine handles the antimeridian; report dispersion, stopping status and optional held-out geodesic errors.
